verdict.rationale: INPI's service pages explain IP tasks in plain, second-person Portuguese rather than statute text. Examples: what qualifies for a patent (docs-1), the provisional patent as a "simple, easy and accessible" route that is then converted to a definitive application (docs-2, docs-4), what a logo is (docs-18), and how to oppose a conflicting application (docs-23). There is also a dedicated online filing guide for trademarks and logos (docs-32). missing for 10: evidence of the actual step-by-step walkthrough content (only the guide's title and sequencing hints are shown), independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers can follow it.
